name: jwt-glance
description: Offline JWT decoder with ambient expiration status, CodeLens and secure claim inspection for VS Code

commands.title: JWT Glance: Inspect Token at Cursor
JWT Glance: Inspect Token from Clipboard

jwtGlance.enabled.description: Enable or disable JWT Glance ambient inspection.

jwtGlance.position.description: Where to render the JWT glance badge: 'top' (CodeLens above the line), 'left' (inline color chip before token), or 'both' (CodeLens and inline color chip).

jwtGlance.overviewRuler.description: Display color-coded health indicators for JWT tokens in the editor scrollbar overview ruler.

jwtGlance.dimExpiredTokens.description: Subtly dim expired JWT token text in the editor to visually distinguish active vs dead credentials.

jwtGlance.expiringSoonThreshold.description: Threshold in seconds (default 1800s / 30m) under which an active token is flagged with an amber 'Expiring Soon' warning.

jwtGlance.maxLineLength.description: Maximum line length to scan for candidate JWTs.

jwtGlance.maxDocumentCharacters.description: Maximum document character count to scan (default 524,288 characters, ~512 KB). Documents exceeding this limit are skipped to maintain editor responsiveness.

jwtGlance.exclude.description: Glob patterns of files and directories to exclude from ambient scanning.

jwtGlance.languages.description: List of language identifiers to scan for JWTs (use ['*'] for all languages).

scripts.test:compile: node -e "fs.rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p ./tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run test:compile && npm run test:run
